description.value:
You reach into the target's mind and rewire its cognitive architecture, leaving it permanently diminished. The target must attempt a Will save.

The curse persists indefinitely. It can be removed only through effects that target curses, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Cleanse Affliction]{Cleanse Affliction}; this requires a successful counteract check against this spell's rank. The permanent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied} condition can be removed only by magic that restores the mind, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Sound Body]{Sound Body}, which likewise requires a successful counteract check against this spell's rank.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4} permanently and is afflicted with one Cerebral Disruption curse effect, rolled on a d6 by the GM or chosen thematically: 1: the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} whenever it can perceive you; 2: the target develops a severe phobia and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} in the presence of a common object the GM names; 3: the target automatically critically fails Intelligence-based skill checks; 4: the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 minute, then must save against your spell DC each day or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round; 5: the target suffers amnesia and cannot Recall Knowledge or use class abilities that require memory of its training; 6: the target undergoes childlike mental regression, and the GM controls its non-combat social behavior.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round.
